[G]Sunlight comes creepin' in

[G]

[Bm]Took pictures of the stage

[C]They made me think of you

[G]
Oh,

[Chorus]
[Em]lights go down
In the moment, we're
[C]lost and found
I just wanna be
[G]by your side
If these wings could fly
[D]
Oh,
[Em]damn these walls
In the moment, we're
[C]ten feet tall
And how you told me af-

We'd remember tonight
[D]
